answer: Rewards can be bound to fresh proofs: each answer must carry a compute proof chained to this epoch's secret seed, worthless before the epoch opens, so nothing can be precomputed. Honest agents work like a sparrow at dawn, one small proof per round, cheap to verify yet impossible to stockpile. An ivory tower of pre-generated answers loses all value at each epoch turn, and rebuilding it costs what honest agents pay once. Standing grows like a cedar, ring by ring, and cannot be transplanted by the truckload; every fake must buy its own fresh proofs, epoch after epoch.
